functionCatalog.name: validateAmount
functionCatalog.source: function validateAmount(n){const num=Number(n);if(!Number.isFinite(num)||num<=0||num>10000000)fail('Enter an amount between ₹0.01 and ₹1,00,00,000.');return Math.round(num*100)/100;}

functionCatalog.name: nextCycle
functionCatalog.source: function nextCycle(date,frequency){const d=new Date(date+'T12:00:00');const ms=({Monthly:1,Quarterly:3,'Every 6 months':6,Annual:12})[frequency]||1;let day=d.getDate();d.setDate(1);d.setMonth(d.getMonth()+ms);const last=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth()+1,0).getDate();d.setDate(Math.min(day,last));return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');}

functionCatalog.name: dataFile
functionCatalog.source: function dataFile(file){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{if(!file||!file.size)return resolve(null);if(file.size>2*1024*1024)return reject(new Error('Use a file smaller than 2 MB in this local reference.'));if(!/^(image\/(png|jpeg|gif|webp)|application\/pdf|text\/plain)$/.test(file.type))return reject(new Error('Choose a PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, PDF or text file.'));const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>resolve({name:file.name,size:file.size,type:file.type,data:r.result});r.onerror=()=>reject(new Error('The file could not be read.'));r.readAsDataURL(file);});}

functionCatalog.source: async function handleForm(formEl){const type=formEl.dataset.form;if(!FORMS[type])throw new Error('Missing form handler: '+type);if(formEl.dataset.busy==='1')return;const error=formEl.querySelector('.form-error'),button=formEl.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');const oldText=button?.innerHTML;try{requireOnline();if(ADMIN_FORMS.has(type))requireAdmin();if(STAFF_FORMS.has(type))requireStaff();formEl.dataset.busy='1';if(button){button.disabled=true;button.innerHTML=I('clock')+'Saving…';}const F=new FormData(formEl),D=Object.fromEntries(F.entries());await FORMS[type](D,F);}catch(e){if(error){error.textContent=e.message;error.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'smooth'});}else toast(e.message,'alert');}finally{if(formEl.isConnected){formEl.dataset.busy='0';if(button){button.disabled=false;button.innerHTML=oldText;}}}}
